title: Grant (money)
author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
paragraphs: A grant is money given by a government, company, foundation, or trust to a group, school, business, or person. Unlike a loan, a grant does not need to be paid back. Grants help with a specific project or goal and often have rules about how the money can be used.
People may need to write applications or proposals to get a grant. They might also have to follow rules and report on how they use the money.
